author: GitHub
description:
Tech social media has been debating whether the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is dead, arguing that basic shell commands are enough. But as Gergely Orosz points out, once you reach enterprise scale like Uber, AI agents need secure and consistent connections to internal services. MCP was built exactly for this. Plus, we talk about the FastMCP team hosting a literal funeral for MCP on April 1st in NYC. Let us know if you are team MCP or team CLI in the comments!

#MCP #AI #FastMCP
